_lane: colours are Art's lane, read from data/art/energy-lanes.json lanes.<lane>.kinds (core, main and edge for bolt, lob, beam, grab and trap) and never copied here; light.colour is the lane's light_colour, the bolt main
identity: precision: small, exact and many; he holds you still and denies the ground you stand on, then finishes by hand, never off the bind (Legal e12)
_about: The Rival (the Anti-hero), parked. Combat and Choreography, 2026-10-23. Page: rival.md. Only the cells E81 leaves to a fighter, inside their bands, with README section 2's templates; the grammar, ki (E100), hit-stop (E102) and every other number are the frame's. Legal's conditions fitted: docs/legal/energy-overhaul-screen.md e10-e15, fx08; Game Design amendments to E14, E47, E50, E61, E96.

light._bands: speed 69 a tick (within 20% of 60); worth 0.9 of the frame's bolt (within 15%); tap, mash and stream pace are E20-E23
light.look: Tapped or mashed: one needle flicked off the edge of the blade hand. Held: the stream's opening 8 leave as a fan from one backhand sweep, then the blade hand flicks back and forth in a short arc, a needle off each end. The other hand behind his back. Never both palms pumping in turn. One steady light at the hand, not a flash per needle; hits build one steady scorch glow (fx08).

medium.shape: a thick hexagonal block tumbling end over end, thrown overhand with one hand; never a thin spinning slab, never held, charged or raised overhead, never a sphere (Legal e15)

l2.what: it lands where aimed and bursts, then cracks into three smaller blocks that hop to staggered spots on the line toward him (near, mid, far; the far one on him) and burst together as they land
l2._note: worth in lobs; 1.65 is inside 15% of the reference 1.5. Spots are set at the split from his position then, so moving in the 12 ticks clears them and standing, guarding or hovering takes all three. One knock-back (4 bh) on the shared landing. A dodge tap as they land slips all three; a shot of trade power 2 or more sets a piece off early. Two burst events for the flash check (fx08): the first burst and the pieces landing together. 12 ki, trade power 5 (E32). Y is a hold from 16 ticks (E14)

medium.look: Low and quick arc. The palm turns up beside the shoulder in the 12-tick wind-up, a thick block forms on it, one overhand loop releases it and it tumbles end over end. It lands with a hexagonal burst; at level 2 it cracks into three along its facets.

heavy.look: In the 16-tick wind-up the plates on his forearm stand up and stack toward the fist, a thin edge light along them, the fist drawn back at shoulder height. A straight punch sends a ram of stacked hexagonal plates, point first. On contact the stack bursts open flat, its plates shattering outward in a hexagonal ring over the frame's 2 bh crater and column of flame. Never a ball of light round the fist.
heavy._bands: worth 1.1 heavies (within 15%); wind-up, seeking, knock-back 5 bh, 10 ki and trade power 4 are E41

beam.shape: a straight, parallel, unrotating sheaf of straight beams: thin lances, one off each plate on his forearm (7, 19, 37 by level). Violet and magenta alternate along each lance, never around it (e11-e14). Split by a perfect block, it forks straight.
beam.end: The lances run out from the outside in, the centre lance last. Lances that missed stand in the ground along the trench and smoulder, with no flash; the whole line is one flash event at most (fx08). It is the trench's mark, no extra damage to a fighter.
beam._bands: levels at the frame's 30/54/84; lengths 20/36/54 ticks, worth x1.0/1.6/2.4 of a heavy and ki 12/20/32 are E43, so damage and length sit inside the 15% and 25% bands. Pulses are E50 (each adds 4 ticks of length)

trait._note: 1.0 by E96: the trait changes only how a surge and a buckle look, never the push. A straight, unrotating press in place of the README's first template, per Legal e11-e14

beam.pulseLook: Each B press: his free hand's knife-edge strikes down the firing forearm and a swell runs up the bundle to the front, under a 10% brightness step (fx08).
beam.struggleLook: On each surge the sheaf presses straight and tightens into a narrower bundle, its tips stepping forward one after another. Losing, the bundle bulges and quivers as the lances bow, never thins, and loose tips fall and scorch the ground.
beam.chargeLook: Side-on, the firing arm drawn back at shoulder height, the free hand behind his back, as in his stream (Legal e10, e15). Each level lights one more forearm plate, a step brighter at the hand, never a ball.
beam.loaded: Held at level 3 it stays loaded at 4 ki a second and never fires by itself; when his ki can no longer pay, it steps down a level, and below level 1 it holds as Rank Breaker (E47). Let go before level 1 and it is Rank Breaker (E40).
beam._width: §20 item 1: drawn width (widthMul) x0.4 to x1.6, hit width (hitWidthMul) x0.7 to x1.3

grab.ringLook: A thin open loop of violet light that leaves his hand on a straight-arm thrust, flies facing forward at hand height, never spinning, and snaps shut round the arms and torso, pinning the arms to his sides. Never a disc, a hoop or an edge; never held, charged or raised above the head; never cuts or throws sparks (e11-e13). It dims in six steps as the catch runs out.

bind.what: A in the catch: the loop pulls tight and he is held where he is; the Rival's next shot lands as on an open fighter, full worth and reel
bind._note: never past the 40-tick catch; the way out (E64) works throughout. No slow motion, zoom or taunt over a bound fighter, and the bind never leads into a finisher: the ring lets go first (Legal e12)

grab.held: Aim (E61): held past 14 ticks, the stick leads the throw up to 4 bh ahead along his travel, as a lob's landing, and the loop flies to where he will be. If he is not there it closes on empty air and fizzles. 14 ki.
answers: A dodge tap in its last 8 ticks slips it.
A shot of trade power 2 or more that meets it in flight breaks it.
A blow that lands on the Rival in his 10-tick wind-up stops it.
Caught: each press takes 4 ticks off the hold, one counted every 6 ticks (E64).
Caught: RT's burst breaks it after its first 12 ticks.
The aimed throw: change course after it leaves his hand.
Limits: the 90-tick grab lockout, and 120 ticks before a thrown fighter can be grabbed again (E67).
grab.reads: A thin violet loop flying at hand height, then closed round his arms and torso; he struggles and braces against it, never hangs limp. Arms and torso only, never throat, face or hair.
grab._bands: arrives within 25 ticks, 17% faster than the frame's 30 (inside E81's 20%); catch 40 at most
grab._callout: Legal ln06: one call-out per grab, on the throw or in the first 10 ticks of the catch, inside the hit-stop and never extending it; nothing said over the rest of the catch, the payoff or a kneel

bindShot._ruled: §20 item 3: a shot fired inside the catch lands as on an open fighter if it arrives within 6 ticks of the catch's end

trap.what: Pressure Plate: a flat hexagonal plate set into the ground or hanging flat in the air. Crossed, it fires a fan of needles up from it: area denial of the air above a spot.

numbers._bands: worth 0.9 of a heavy at most, within 15% of a level-1 beam (x1.0). Lay price (guard down 12 ticks, 12 ki), arming 30 ticks, the 6-tick flare, one trap, 12 s fizzle are E72-E76
numbers._sim: proposed as one area hit (a cone volume) drawn as 12 needles, so it spends no shot slots
numbers._areaHit: §20 item 4: the needle fan is one area hit, drawn as needles; it spends no shot slots

trap.trigger: His body crossing the zone (E74's 'across its zone'). Its facets light for the 6-tick flare, then the fan erupts. A send that carries either fighter through it sets it off at once, with no flare.
trap.answer: Go round it or above 6 bh; shoot it with a lob or heavier; guard at the guard's rate; dodge tap in the flare; send the Rival into it (E78).
trap.look: Small, flat and violet: dim while arming, a slow glow when armed, its facets lighting in turn through the flare, then needles straight up in a fan. One flash event. Where the Protagonist's pillar throws and the Empress's line cuts across, his plate denies the air above a spot.
trap._guard: §20 item 9: no trap goes through a guard; a guard takes it at the guard's rate (only grabs and snares beat a guard)
trap._throw: §20 item 2: a trap's throw is a knock-back, never a send, at most 6 bh on either axis

snare.look: The thin loop laid open in the air or flat on the ground, dim until armed. It catches as the grab; the payoff is the bind.

mines.spark: A single needle standing point up, glowing. A string of them flares staggered.
mines.blast: A small hexagonal slab hanging flat.

collateral: Near occupied buildings his beam and his lob's burst widen to 1.3 (E113). His mines, plate and snare don't hold for people (E79), and none ever moves toward them. Casualties and fleeing people feed menace (the shared rule). The collateral budget caps the deaths at every tier (E110); nothing scores deaths (E117).
forms: Pride ascension; looks, and numbers only inside the bands. Regalia: his forearm plates glow a step brighter and the stream's opening 8 leave from them; nothing circles his body (E6, e11). Sovereign: the sheaf thickens to 19/37/61 lances and his spread tightens to 3 degrees. Apex: needles at speedMul 1.2 and Rank Breaker at dmgMul 1.15, the tops of their bands. Pride crashed: he drops a form at once; a charge in hand is knocked out (costs nothing, E45) and a live catch lets go.

en.rival.light.tap.tell: the forearm plate's edge lights on the press
en.rival.light.tap.pose: a short flick of the blade hand at chest height; the other hand behind his back

en.rival.light.mash.pose: the flick repeated, alternating ends of a short arc

en.rival.light.stream.active: while held: the opening 8, then one every 8 ticks
en.rival.light.stream.tell: one steady light at the hand
en.rival.light.stream.pose: one backhand sweep throws the opening fan, then the blade hand flicks back and forth in a short arc at chest height; chin up

en.rival.medium.tap.tell: the palm turns up beside the shoulder and a thick hexagonal block forms on it
en.rival.medium.tap.pose: one overhand loop, released at the top of the arc; one hand

en.rival.medium.l1.tell: the block on the palm a step brighter, edges lit
en.rival.medium.l1.pose: the arm cocked further back, his head turned to the landing, then the full loop

en.rival.medium.l2.tell: a second brightness step; faint lines across the block where it will crack
en.rival.medium.l2.pose: as level 1; on landing it bursts, and three pieces hop to near, mid and far spots and burst together 12 ticks later

en.rival.heavy.tap.tell: the forearm plates stand up and stack toward the fist, a thin edge light along them
en.rival.heavy.tap.pose: the fist drawn back at shoulder height, then a straight punch; one arm

en.rival.beam.charge.tell: one more forearm plate lit per level, a click and a rumble tick
en.rival.beam.charge.pose: side-on, the firing arm drawn back at shoulder height, the free hand behind his back; never at the hip, never a ball in the palm, never a hand on the firing arm

en.rival.beam.fire.tell: the arm snaps straight at him
en.rival.beam.fire.pose: the arm straight, fist closed, the lit plates firing their lances together; rooted

en.rival.beam.pulse.pose: the free hand a shoulder width away or behind his back, never touching the firing arm (Legal e15)

en.rival.beam.struggle.tell: his back foot digs in; the bundle tightens on a surge, bulges and quivers when losing
en.rival.beam.struggle.pose: the firing arm locked, the free hand behind his back, chin up

en.rival.grab.tap.tell: the blade hand drawn back level with his chest, the forearm plate's edge lit
en.rival.grab.tap.pose: a straight-arm thrust at hand height; the loop leaves the hand facing forward

en.rival.grab.held.tell: the thrust held back past the hold point, his eyes on the point ahead of the foe
en.rival.grab.held.pose: the same straight-arm thrust, angled to the lead point

en.rival.grab.bind.active: to the shot's landing or the catch's end
en.rival.grab.bind.tell: a short closing pull of his fist
en.rival.grab.bind.pose: he closes the throwing hand and draws it in an inch; the loop tightens

en.rival.grab.caught.tell: the loop closed round his arms and torso, dimming in six steps
en.rival.grab.caught.pose: arms pinned at his sides, shoulders working against the loop, braced; never limp; keeps half his nudge

en.rival.trap.lay.tell: his guard drops for its 12 ticks (E72); the free fist driven down at his feet
en.rival.trap.lay.pose: the plated forearm up before his face as he lays; a plate sets where the fist lands

en.rival.trap.fire.tell: the plate's facets light in turn through the flare, with a rising note
en.rival.trap.fire.pose: the needles leave the plate straight up in a fan

en.rival.snare.lay.tell: his guard drops for its 8 ticks (E72); the open hand sets the loop off his fingers
en.rival.snare.lay.pose: the loop set open in the air or laid flat

en.rival.mine.spark.tell: his guard drops for its 4 ticks (E72)
en.rival.mine.spark.pose: a needle flicked down off the plate's edge to stand point up

en.rival.mine.blast.tell: his guard drops for its 8 ticks (E72)
en.rival.mine.blast.pose: a small slab set flat off the palm

legalAsks: Lance Sheaf: thin straight parallel lances, tints alternating along each lance, a straight, parallel, unrotating sheaf of straight beams; the struggle a straight press with tips stepping forward (e11-e14).
Rank Ring: a thin loop thrown from the hand at hand height, closing round arms and torso; never a disc, hoop or edge, never spinning, never raised.
Rank Breaker: a ram of stacked hexagonal plates from a straight punch; no ball of light round the fist.
Stair Split: a thick block tumbling end over end that cracks into three pieces hopping to staggered spots and bursting together; two burst events for fx08.
Pressure Plate: a fan of needles erupting up from a flat plate.
The stream: one arm flicking needles from a short arc, the other hand behind his back.
Names: Pin Volley, Stair Split, Rank Breaker, Rank Ring, Pressure Plate, Lance Sheaf (Narrative's, re-fitted).
Lance Sheaf charge: the free hand behind his back, never on the firing arm or shoulder (e10, e15).
